data.summary: Revenue ($245.1B, up 15.7% from $211.9B), net income ($88.1B), total assets ($512.2B) and cash and cash equivalents ($18.3B) all match Microsoft's fiscal 2024 results. Operating income was left out of the issues list because the text says it has already been verified. However, Microsoft reported about $109.4B in fiscal 2024 operating income, not $88.5B. The stated figure looks like it was mixed up with net income and should be checked against the 10-K.
